customer_reply.title: Reply to the customer
customer_reply.text:
To: Arjun Patel (CUST-19008)
From: Grievance Redressal Cell, Sunrise Bank
Subject: Your complaint MIL-24008: Rs 10,000 on 09 Oct 2026 (RRN 667890123456)

Dear Arjun Patel,

Thank you for your complaint received on 10 Oct 2026. We have investigated it using your documents and our own payment records.

What happened: Rs 10,000 was debited from your account on 09 Oct 2026 [1][2]. However, the ATM did not dispense cash [3] and no automatic reversal followed [2].

What we will do: Under the RBI rules for failed transactions, this amount had to be returned by 14 Oct 2026 (T+5) [4]. We are crediting Rs 10,000 to your account, together with compensation of Rs 300 for 3 days of delay (3 days x Rs 100 = Rs 300) [4]. Total: Rs 10,300.

If you are not satisfied with this reply, you may complain to the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in, free of charge, from 09 Nov 2026 if the matter is still unresolved, and no later than 07 Feb 2027 [5]. Helpline 14448.

Yours sincerely,
Priya Sharma
Grievance Redressal Officer, Sunrise Bank
